# Hash-pinned `uv` for every hosted workflow job (security audit R2, M8).
# `pip install --require-hashes -r` refuses any artifact whose sha256 is not
# listed, so a compromised index or a republished wheel cannot substitute a
# different `uv` into a job that goes on to hold an id-token or a secret.
# Hashes are the PyPI-published digests for 0.11.33 (read from
# https://pypi.org/pypi/uv/0.11.33/json on 2026-10-07): macOS arm64 wheel,
# manylinux_2_17 x86_64 wheel, sdist. Bump the version and ALL hashes
# together; a version-only edit fails closed. The self-hosted publish runner's
# root-owned uv must be re-provisioned to the SAME version in the same window
# (docs/runbooks/self-hosted-runner.md, "Upgrading the pinned uv").
uv==0.11.33 \
    --hash=sha256:8017991a398a55d177c33ecdb29beb33e7b53969921183e4681e3e5b278d73c2 \
    --hash=sha256:9542178978b0b6f16a7ae99e55aca039f493a1edb373a15d7993eab80a28615a \
    --hash=sha256:a4411bf854f5fe3d4b78d37dd2e4b84e0b99fbb0bd185de1511a8515404e04a8
